setup.kitVibeConfig:
# Mistral Vibe settings for this folder, written by `npm create nodegx`. Start Vibe here with:
#
#   vibe --legacy-harness
#
# Vibe's default harness hides a tool's error messages from the model, and NodeGX answers every refused change
# with what to fix, so the legacy harness builds better apps. Edit anything below; it is never overwritten.

active_model = "deepseek-v4.1-flash"

[[models]]
name = "mistral-large-4"
provider = "mistral"
alias = "mistral-large-4"
display_name = "Mistral Large 4"
temperature = 1.0
thinking = "high"
thinking_levels = ["low", "high"]
max_context_length = 1000000
input_price = 1.36
output_price = 4.18
cached_input_price = 0.14

[[mcp_servers]]
name = "nodegx"
transport = "stdio"
command = "npx"
args = ["-y", "@nodegx/mcp@0.2.4", "--allow-writes", "--profile", "vibe"]
startup_timeout_sec = 240
tool_timeout_sec = 600

[tools.nodegx_list_projects]
permission = "always"

[tools.nodegx_open_project]
permission = "always"

[tools.nodegx_create_project]
permission = "always"

[tools.nodegx_list_examples]
permission = "always"

[tools.nodegx_get_example]
permission = "always"

[tools.nodegx_find_tools]
permission = "always"

[tools.nodegx_call_tool]
permission = "always"
